newsitem.title: USA: American Exploration abandons Brazos well.
newsitem.headline: American Exploration abandons Brazos well.

text.p: American Exploration Co said Thursday it has plugged and abandoned the Brazos 478 3 well, which was drilled two fault blocks north of the 478 2 discovery well.

The 2 well encountered about 75 feet of Miocene gas pay in one of several prospective fault blocks. The 3 well encountered sand in the prospective interval, but was wet, the company said, adding it plans further drilling on the Brazos 478 Block in the Gulf of Mexico offshore Texas.

"Although we did not encounter gas at this aggressive step-out location, we remain optimistic about the initial discovery and will continue our efforts to develop it," chief executive Mark Andrews said.
